dialogue.title: 誰說得念大學才有未來？

text.traditional: 恭喜你弟弟參加網球比賽得到了第一名。好久沒看到他了，他最近怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 恭喜你弟弟参加网球比赛得到了第一名。好久没看到他了，他最近怎么样？
text.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ dìdi cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài dédào le dìyī míng. Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào tā le, tā zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
text.english: Congratulations on your younger brother taking first place in the tennis tournament! I haven't seen him in a while; how has he been lately?

text.traditional: 他忙著準備今年的大學考試，總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
text.simplified: 他忙着准备今年的大学考试，总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
text.pinyin: Tā mángzhe zhǔnbèi jīnnián de dàxué kǎoshì, zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì túrán xǐng guòlái.
text.english: He's busy preparing for this year's college entrance exams. He never sleeps restfully and often wakes up suddenly in the middle of the night.

text.traditional: 記得你說過，你弟弟學習和運動的表現都很好。我想只要心情放輕鬆就沒問題了。
text.simplified: 记得你说过，你弟弟学习和运动的表现都很好。我想只要心情放轻松就没问题了。
text.pinyin: Jìde nǐ shuō guò, nǐ dìdi xuéxí hé yùndòng de biǎoxiàn dōu hěn hǎo. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào xīnqíng fàng qīngsōng jiù méi wèntí le.
text.english: I remember you said your brother performs well in both academics and sports. I think as long as he stays relaxed, he'll be fine.

text.traditional: 問題是，我爸媽希望他能考上前三名的大學，不是打球得第一，他們要求他把全部的時間都拿來準備考試。可是我弟弟覺得打球不會影響他念書，他們還因為這件事吵了一架。
text.simplified: 问题是，我爸妈希望他能考上前三名的大学，不是打球得第一，他们要求他把全部的时间都拿来准备考试。可是我弟弟觉得打球不会影响他念书，他们还因为这件事吵了一架。
text.pinyin: Wèntí shì, wǒ bà mā xīwàng tā néng kǎo shàng qián sān míng de dàxué, búshì dǎqiú dé dìyī, tāmen yāoqiú tā bǎ quánbù de shíjiān dōu nálái zhǔnbèi kǎoshì. Kěshì wǒ dìdi juéde dǎqiú bú huì yǐngxiǎng tā niànshū, tāmen hái yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì chǎo le yí jià.
text.english: The problem is that my parents hope he can test into a top-three university rather than placing first in ball games; they demand he devote all his time to exam prep. But my brother believes playing ball won't hurt his studies, and they even had a big argument over this.

text.traditional: 哦？你弟弟的運動成績那麼好，我以為你爸媽會為他高興。
text.simplified: 哦？你弟弟的运动成绩那么好，我以为你爸妈会为他高兴。
text.pinyin: Ó? Nǐ dìdi de yùndòng chéngjī nàme hǎo, wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bà mā huì wèi tā gāoxìng.
text.english: Oh? Your brother's athletic achievements are so stellar; I thought your parents would be thrilled for him.

text.traditional: 他們是很高興，可是現在要考大學，情況就不同了。我曾經有一次，考試前想跟同學去露營，爸媽知道了就罵我：「快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎麼解釋他們都不聽，讓我難過了半天。
text.simplified: 他们是很高兴，可是现在要考大学，情况就不同了。我曾经有一次，考试前想跟同学去露营，爸妈知道了就骂我：「快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎么解释他们都不听，让我难过了半天。
text.pinyin: Tāmen shì hěn gāoxìng, kěshì xiànzài yào kǎo dàxué, qíngkuàng jiù bùtóng le. Wǒ céngjīng yǒu yí cì, kǎoshì qián xiǎng gēn tóngxué qù lùyíng, bà mā zhīdào le jiù mà wǒ: “Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chū qù wán?” Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme jiěshì tāmen dōu bù tīng, ràng wǒ nánguò le bàntiān.
text.english: They are happy, but now that college exams are ahead, the situation is different. Once before an exam, I wanted to go camping with classmates; when my parents found out, they scolded me: 'Exams are around the corner, why aren't you studying at home instead of wanting to go out playing?' No matter how I explained, they wouldn't listen, which made me upset for a long time.

text.traditional: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考試還要重要啊！再說，孩子怎麼受得了一直被逼著念書呢？
text.simplified: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考试还要重要啊！再说，孩子怎么受得了一直被逼着念书呢？
text.pinyin: Kěshì, shēngmìng zhōng yǒu hěn duō shìqíng bǐ kǎoshì háiyào zhòngyào a! Zàishuō, háizi zěnme shòudeliǎo yìzhí bèi bī zhe niànshū ne?
text.english: Still, there are many things in life even more important than exams! Besides, how can any kid stand being forced to study constantly?

text.traditional: 我爸媽才不這麼想。其實有一些高中老師也是這樣，雖然他們也教導學生做人做事的道理，但臺灣社會很重視升學，所以考試就變成教學的重心了。
text.simplified: 我爸妈才不这么想。其实有一些高中老师也是这样，虽然他们也教导学生做人做事的道理，但台湾社会很重视升学，所以考试就变成教学的重心了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bà mā cái bú zhème xiǎng. Qíshí yǒu yìxiē gāozhōng lǎoshī yě shì zhèyàng, suīrán tāmen yě jiàodǎo xuéshēng zuòrénzuòshì de dàolǐ, dàn Táiwān shèhuì hěn zhòngshì shēngxué, suǒyǐ kǎoshì jiù biànchéng jiàoxué de zhòngxīn le.
text.english: My parents certainly don't think that way. Actually, some high school teachers are like that too: while they teach life principles, Taiwanese society values college advancement so much that exams become the core focus of teaching.

text.traditional: 難怪你爸媽也認為考試最重要，好像只要考上好大學，將來就能有成就。
text.simplified: 难怪你爸妈也认为考试最重要，好像只要考上好大学，将来就能有成就。
text.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ bà mā yě rènwéi kǎoshì zuì zhòngyào, hǎoxiàng zhǐyào kǎo shàng hǎo dàxué, jiānglái jiù néng yǒu chéngjiù.
text.english: No wonder your parents think exams are paramount, as if as long as you get into a good college, you will achieve success in the future.

text.traditional: 是啊，就是因為這樣，所以老師要求學生做一堆測驗題目、記一堆筆記。要是孩子考不及格或學習成果不好，家長就逼孩子去補習，就算孩子再不滿也得去。
text.simplified: 是啊，就是因为这样，所以老师要求学生做一堆测验题目、记一堆笔记。要是孩子考不及格或学习成果不好，家长就逼孩子去补习，就算孩子再不满也得去。
text.pinyin: Shì a, jiùshì yīnwèi zhèyàng, suǒyǐ lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng zuò yì duī cèyàn tímù, jì yì duī bǐjì. Yàoshì háizi kǎo bù jígé huò xuéxí chéngguǒ bùhǎo, jiāzhǎng jiù bī háizi qù bǔxí, jiùsuàn háizi zài bùmǎn yě děi qù.
text.english: Yeah, exactly because of that, teachers demand students do piles of test questions and take heaps of notes. If a child fails or performs poorly, parents force them into cram schools no matter how unhappy they are.

text.traditional: 不過，我聽語言交換的朋友說，現在不少臺灣老師的教學方式變活潑了。他們利用有趣的教材和網路工具，帶領學生吸收新知識，也讓本來沒有自信的學生，願意主動舉手請教老師了。
text.simplified: 不过，我听语言交换的朋友说，现在不少台湾老师的教学方式变活泼了。他们利用有趣的教材和网路工具，带领学生吸收新知识，也让本来没有自信的学生，愿意主动举手请教老师了。
text.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ tīng yǔyán jiāohuàn de péngyǒu shuō, xiànzài bùshǎo Táiwān lǎoshī de jiàoxué fāngshì biàn huópō le. Tāmen lìyòng yǒuqù de jiàocái hé wǎnglù gōngjù, dàilǐng xuéshēng xīshōu xīn zhīshì, yě ràng běnlái méiyǒu zìxìn de xuéshēng, yuànyì zhǔdòng jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī le.
text.english: However, I heard from language exchange friends that many Taiwanese teachers are adopting livelier methods now. They use interesting teaching materials and online tools to lead students in taking in new knowledge, and they have also made students who used to lack confidence willing to raise their hands on their own and ask the teacher questions.

text.traditional: 是啊，不只教學方式變了，升學制度也改了。像有一些學生體育、美術或音樂的成績非常好，就能以特殊表現，選擇理想的大學。
text.simplified: 是啊，不只教学方式变了，升学制度也改了。像有一些学生体育、美术或音乐的成绩非常好，就能以特殊表现，选择理想的大学。
text.pinyin: Shì a, bù zhǐ jiàoxué fāngshì biàn le, shēngxué zhìdù yě gǎi le. Xiàng yǒu yìxiē xuéshēng tǐyù, měishù huò yīnyuè de chéngjī fēicháng hǎo, jiù néng yǐ tèshū biǎoxiàn, xuǎnzé lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
text.english: Right, not only have teaching methods changed, but the college admission system has changed too. For example, some students with very good results in sports, art or music can use these special achievements to choose their ideal university.

text.traditional: 我覺得這樣比較合理。像歐洲就有不少水準很高的職業學校，培養學生的專業能力，將來就比較容易找到工作。
text.simplified: 我觉得这样比较合理。像欧洲就有不少水准很高的职业学校，培养学生的专业能力，将来就比较容易找到工作。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèyàng bǐjiào hélǐ. Xiàng Ōuzhōu jiù yǒu bùshǎo shuǐzhǔn hěn gāo de zhíyè xuéxiào, péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì, jiānglái jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
text.english: I think that's more reasonable. Europe, for example, has quite a few high-standard vocational schools that train students' professional skills, so it's easier for them to find jobs in the future.

text.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。他邊旅行邊學外文，後來就留在當地的職業學校念服裝設計，現在已經是服裝公司的大老闆了。
text.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。他边旅行边学外文，后来就留在当地的职业学校念服装设计，现在已经是服装公司的大老板了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yíge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎo shàng dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué. Tā biān lǚxíng biān xué wàiwén, hòulái jiù liú zài dāngdì de zhíyè xuéxiào niàn fúzhuāng shèjì, xiànzài yǐjīng shì fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn le.
text.english: I had a high school classmate who didn't test into college; his parents didn't get angry at all, but sent him on a study trip to Italy instead. He studied foreign languages while traveling, later studied fashion design at a local vocational academy, and is now the boss of an apparel company.

text.traditional: 這樣的成就也很好啊！誰說一定要念大學才有美好的未來呢？
text.simplified: 这样的成就也很好啊！谁说一定要念大学才有美好的未来呢？
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng de chéngjiù yě hěn hǎo a! Shéi shuō yídìng yào niàn dàxué cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái ne?
text.english: That kind of accomplishment is wonderful too! Who can say that one must attend university to have a bright future?

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Back to Normal with V過來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone comes back to a normal or better state, such as waking up (醒過來), correcting a habit (改過來) or finally realizing something (明白過來).
grammarPages.explanation: 「動詞＋過來」的「過來」是趨向補語，例如：請你把書拿過來。另外，「過來」還有回到或恢復到原來狀態的意思，大多表示正常的或是較好的狀態。例如：醒過來、改過來、明白過來。相反的，「過去」是從正常的狀態到另一種不好的狀態，比「過來」使用得少，例如：暈過去 (fainted)、昏過去 (fainted)。

text.traditional: ……總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
text.simplified: ……总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
text.pinyin: …Zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì túrán xǐng guòlái.
text.english: …He always sleeps restlessly, and he suddenly wakes up in the middle of the night.

text.traditional: 被媽媽罵了好幾次以後，弟弟終於把亂丟髒衣服的壞習慣改過來了。
text.simplified: 被妈妈骂了好几次以后，弟弟终于把乱丢脏衣服的坏习惯改过来了。
text.pinyin: Bèi māma mà le hǎojǐ cì yǐhòu, dìdi zhōngyú bǎ luàndiū zāng yīfu de huài xíguàn gǎi guòlái le.
text.english: After being scolded by Mom several times, my younger brother finally broke his bad habit of leaving dirty clothes lying around.

text.traditional: 早上上班時，發現大家都對著我笑，過了一會兒我才明白過來，原來我穿著睡褲出門。
text.simplified: 早上上班时，发现大家都对着我笑，过了一会儿我才明白过来，原来我穿着睡裤出门。
text.pinyin: Zǎoshàng shàngbān shí, fāxiàn dàjiā dōu duì zhe wǒ xiào, guò le yìhuǐr wǒ cái míngbái guòlái, yuánlái wǒ chuān zhe shuìkù chūmén.
text.english: When I went to work this morning, I noticed everyone was laughing at me. After a while I finally realized why: I had left the house in my pajama pants.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 過來 of 動詞＋過來 is a directional complement. For example, 請你把書拿過來。In addition, 過來 has the meaning of returning, or returning to the original state, and primarily indicating a normal or better state. For example, 醒過來, 改過來, 明白過來. On the contrary, 過去 is moving from a normal state to a less ideal one. It is used less frequently than 過來. For example, 暈過去, 昏過去.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Questioning a Wrong Choice with 怎麼不……，反而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Question why someone fails to do what is reasonable and instead does something contrary or inappropriate.
grammarPages.explanation: 「怎麼不……呢？」是「為什麼不……呢？」的意思，表示說話的人對某種情況提出疑問，句尾常跟著「呢」。「怎麼不」後面是說話的人認為應該要做的事或建議；「反而」是連詞，後面是不應該做的或代表說話者的疑問。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 怎麼不 + Expected Action，反而 + Contrary Action + (呢)？

text.traditional: 快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？
text.simplified: 快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？
text.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chūqù wán?
text.english: Exams are coming up. Why aren't you studying at home? Why do you want to go out and play instead?

text.traditional: 你聽不懂老師上課說的，怎麼不舉手請教老師，反而玩起手機來了？
text.simplified: 你听不懂老师上课说的，怎么不举手请教老师，反而玩起手机来了？
text.pinyin: Nǐ tīng bù dǒng lǎoshī shàngkè shuō de, zěnme bù jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī, fǎn'ér wán qǐ shǒujī lái le?
text.english: You couldn't understand what the teacher said in class. Why didn't you raise your hand and ask the teacher? Why did you start playing with your phone instead?

text.traditional:
爸爸：孩子每次把衣服脫了就亂丟，每次都得幫他整理。
媽媽：你怎麼不跟他說，反而老是幫他整理呢？
text.simplified:
爸爸：孩子每次把衣服脱了就乱丢，每次都得帮他整理。
妈妈：你怎么不跟他说，反而老是帮他整理呢？
text.pinyin:
Bàba: Háizi měi cì bǎ yīfu tuō le jiù luàndiū, měi cì dōu děi bāng tā zhěnglǐ.
Māma: Nǐ zěnme bù gēn tā shuō, fǎn'ér lǎoshì bāng tā zhěnglǐ ne?
text.english:
Dad: Every time the kid takes off his clothes, he just throws them all over the place, and every time I have to tidy up after him.
Mom: Why don't you talk to him, instead of always tidying up after him?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 怎麼不……呢？ has the same meaning as 為什麼不……呢？ indicating that the speaker is questioning a certain situation. The end of the sentence is often followed by 呢. 怎麼不 is followed by what the speaker thinks should be done, but 反而 as a conjunction, is followed by what should not be done or the speaker's doubt.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The Opposite of What You'd Expect with 不但不/沒……，反而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that the expected thing did not happen and the opposite happened instead, with 不但不/沒……，反而…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不但不」、「不但沒」後面接的是與說話的人預料相反的情況；「反而」的後面是出乎預料的情況或說話的人認為不應該發生的。有時候「不但」可以省略，例如：颱風快來了，他（不但）沒留在家裡，反而去衝浪，真是太危險了。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不但不/沒 + Expected，反而 + Contrary

text.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。
text.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yíge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎo shàng dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué.
text.english: A high school classmate of mine didn't get into college. His parents didn't get angry at all; instead, they let him go on a study tour in Italy.

text.traditional: 我們公司不但沒給男女員工同樣的工作機會，反而對女員工有許多不合理的要求。
text.simplified: 我们公司不但没给男女员工同样的工作机会，反而对女员工有许多不合理的要求。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī búdàn méi gěi nánnǚ yuángōng tóngyàng de gōngzuò jīhuì, fǎn'ér duì nǚ yuángōng yǒu xǔduō bù hélǐ de yāoqiú.
text.english: Our company not only hasn't given male and female employees the same job opportunities; instead, it makes many unreasonable demands of its female employees.

text.traditional: 小金最近胖了很多，體力也變差了，可是他不但不運動，反而天天約朋友去吃大餐。
text.simplified: 小金最近胖了很多，体力也变差了，可是他不但不运动，反而天天约朋友去吃大餐。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Jīn zuìjìn pàng le hěn duō, tǐlì yě biàn chà le, kěshì tā búdàn bú yùndòng, fǎn'ér tiāntiān yuē péngyǒu qù chī dàcān.
text.english: Xiao Jin has gained a lot of weight recently and his stamina has gotten worse, yet he not only refuses to exercise, but instead invites friends out for big meals every day.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不但不 or 不但沒 is followed by circumstances that are contrary to what the speaker expected; 反而 is followed by an unexpected situation or one the person speaking thinks shouldn't happen. Sometimes 不但 can be omitted. For example, 颱風快來了，他（不但）沒留在家裡，反而去衝浪，真是太危險了。

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Disagree strongly with what someone said by stressing your own view with 才……(呢).
grammarPages.explanation: 這一課的「才」是強調「才」後面所說的話，常用在反駁的時候，句尾常跟「呢」一起使用，例如：「你說那家餐廳的菜好吃，可是我覺得你煮的才好吃呢！」、「小明說我借了他的書，我才沒借呢！」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 才 + (不/沒) + Your Own View + (呢)

text.traditional:
尚恩：可是，生命中有很多事情比考試還要重要啊！……
家豪：我爸媽才不這麼想。……
text.simplified:
尚恩：可是，生命中有很多事情比考试还要重要啊！……
家豪：我爸妈才不这么想。……
text.pinyin:
Shàng'ēn: Kěshì, shēngmìng zhōng yǒu hěn duō shìqíng bǐ kǎoshì háiyào zhòngyào a!…
Jiāháo: Wǒ bàmā cái bú zhème xiǎng.…
text.english:
Shawn: But there are lots of things in life that are more important than exams!…
Jiahao: My parents definitely don't think so…

text.traditional:
A：博物館不遠，我們走路去吧？
B：我才不要呢！搭公車比較快。
text.simplified:
A：博物馆不远，我们走路去吧？
B：我才不要呢！搭公车比较快。
text.pinyin:
A: Bówùguǎn bù yuǎn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba?
B: Wǒ cái bú yào ne! Dā gōngchē bǐjiào kuài.
text.english:
A: The museum isn't far; shall we walk there?
B: No way I'm walking! Taking the bus is faster.

text.traditional:
A：王導演拍的那部戲非常好，今年的最佳導演一定是他。
B：不一定吧，我認為李導演拍的才好呢！
text.simplified:
A：王导演拍的那部戏非常好，今年的最佳导演一定是他。
B：不一定吧，我认为李导演拍的才好呢！
text.pinyin:
A: Wáng dǎoyǎn pāi de nà bù xì fēicháng hǎo, jīnnián de zuìjiā dǎoyǎn yídìng shì tā.
B: Bù yídìng ba, wǒ rènwéi Lǐ dǎoyǎn pāi de cái hǎo ne!
text.english:
A: The film Director Wang made is excellent. This year's Best Director is sure to be him.
B: Not necessarily. I think the one Director Li made is the really good one!

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 才 in this lesson emphasizes what is said after 才. It is often used when refuting something, and the sentence end often uses 呢. For example, 你說那家餐廳的菜好吃，可是我覺得你煮的才好吃呢！Or 小明說我借了他的書，我才沒借呢！

BOOK3_LESSON_NINE_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 5–7 · Real Competence Over Test Scores

text.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。人們似乎認為，成績好就代表書讀得好，書讀得好就會有美好的未來。因此，不少家長希望孩子能上好大學，甚至念到博士。為了達成這個目的，家長從孩子念國小、國中起，就非常注意每科的分數，老是擔心孩子進不了好高中、好大學。
text.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。人们似乎认为，成绩好就代表书读得好，书读得好就会有美好的未来。因此，不少家长希望孩子能上好大学，甚至念到博士。为了达成这个目的，家长从孩子念国小、国中起，就非常注意每科的分数，老是担心孩子进不了好高中、好大学。
text.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì yìzhí dōu hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de xuéxí biǎoxiàn, yóuqí shì kǎoshì de chéngjī. Rénmen sìhū rènwéi, chéngjī hǎo jiù dàibiǎo shū dú de hǎo, shū dú de hǎo jiù huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái. Yīncǐ, bùshǎo jiāzhǎng xīwàng háizi néng shàng hǎo dàxué, shènzhì niàn dào bóshì. Wèile dáchéng zhè ge mùdì, jiāzhǎng cóng háizi niàn guóxiǎo, guózhōng qǐ, jiù fēicháng zhùyì měi kē de fēnshù, lǎoshì dānxīn háizi jìn bùliǎo hǎo gāozhōng, hǎo dàxué.
text.english: Taiwanese society has always attached great importance to students' academic performance, especially test scores. People seem to believe that good grades equate to doing well in school, and doing well in school ensures a bright future. Consequently, many parents hope their children get into prestigious universities or even obtain doctorates. To achieve this goal, parents closely watch scores in every subject starting from elementary and junior high school, perpetually worrying their children won't enter top high schools or universities.

text.traditional: 有一些家長很誇張，不但陪孩子一起補習，還幫他們把筆記寫在本子上、把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。也有家長把孩子的學習時間排得很滿，下課後還叫他們寫很多考卷。後來，大家發現學生雖然掌握了考試的技巧，但在實際生活中碰到困難時，反而缺乏解決問題的能力。畢竟會考試，不代表擁有處理事情的能力。
text.simplified: 有一些家长很夸张，不但陪孩子一起补习，还帮他们把笔记写在本子上、把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。也有家长把孩子的学习时间排得很满，下课后还叫他们写很多考卷。后来，大家发现学生虽然掌握了考试的技巧，但在实际生活中碰到困难时，反而缺乏解决问题的能力。毕竟会考试，不代表拥有处理事情的能力。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng hěn kuāzhāng, búdàn péi háizi yìqǐ bǔxí, hái bāng tāmen bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài biàntiáo shàng, yǐwéi háizi fùxí shí yòngdezháo, zhèyàng kǎoshì de chéngjī jiù huì gèng hǎo. Yě yǒu jiāzhǎng bǎ háizi de xuéxí shíjiān pái de hěn mǎn, xiàkè hòu hái jiào tāmen xiě hěn duō kǎojuàn. Hòulái, dàjiā fāxiàn xuéshēng suīrán zhǎngwò le kǎoshì de jìqiǎo, dàn zài shíjì shēnghuó zhōng pèngdào kùnnán shí, fǎn'ér quēfá jiějué wèntí de nénglì. Bìjìng huì kǎoshì, bú dàibiǎo yǒngyǒu chǔlǐ shìqíng de nénglì.
text.english: Some parents go to extreme lengths: not only attending cram school with their children, but copying notes into notebooks and writing key points on sticky notes, thinking kids will find them useful when reviewing, thereby scoring higher on tests. Other parents pack schedules to the brim and assign piles of test papers after class. Later on, people found that while students mastered test-taking techniques, they lacked problem-solving capabilities when encountering real-world challenges. After all, testing well does not mean having practical competence.

text.traditional: 其實，因為每年出生的孩子越來越少，許多學校的新生也變少了，因為這樣，被大學錄取的機會反而大大地增加了。但是國中、高中的考試沒減少，家長對教育的想法也沒有太大的改變。孩子就算考上了好大學，沒實力的人恐怕畢業後也很難找到工作，更不可能擔任公司的主管，甚至最後變成整個社會的負擔。
text.simplified: 其实，因为每年出生的孩子越来越少，许多学校的新生也变少了，因为这样，被大学录取的机会反而大大地增加了。但是国中、高中的考试没减少，家长对教育的想法也没有太大的改变。孩子就算考上了好大学，没实力的人恐怕毕业后也很难找到工作，更不可能担任公司的主管，甚至最后变成整个社会的负担。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, yīnwèi měi nián chūshēng de háizi yuèláiyuè shǎo, xǔduō xuéxiào de xīnshēng yě biàn shǎo le, yīnwèi zhèyàng, bèi dàxué lùqǔ de jīhuì fǎn'ér dà dà de zēngjiā le. Dànshì guózhōng, gāozhōng de kǎoshì méi jiǎnshǎo, jiāzhǎng duì jiàoyù de xiǎngfǎ yě méiyǒu tài dà de gǎibiàn. Háizi jiùsuàn kǎo shàng le hǎo dàxué, méi shílì de rén kǒngpà bìyè hòu yě hěn nán zhǎodào gōngzuò, gèng bù kěnéng dānrèn gōngsī de zhǔguǎn, shènzhì zuìhòu biànchéng zhěngge shèhuì de fùdān.
text.english: In fact, because fewer children are born each year, many schools have fewer new students, and because of this, the chances of being admitted to a university have instead greatly increased. Yet junior and senior high exams have not decreased, and parents' educational mindset remains mostly unchanged. Even if children get into a good university, those without real ability will probably find it hard to get a job after graduating, let alone become managers at a company, and may even end up as a burden on the whole society.

text.traditional: 這樣的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近幾年，家長和老師終於明白每個孩子都是獨特的，不是每個人都非念大學不可。再說，考試成績好的人，不一定就能幸福過日子。因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案，不僅給孩子自由的空間，發揮出自己的優點，而且還提供更好的教材和教學方式，讓孩子快樂地學習、成長。如果他們的能力可以變得更強，將來就能為社會貢獻一份力量了。
text.simplified: 这样的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近几年，家长和老师终于明白每个孩子都是独特的，不是每个人都非念大学不可。再说，考试成绩好的人，不一定就能幸福过日子。因此，有意义的学习是让孩子以思考代替记答案，不仅给孩子自由的空间，发挥出自己的优点，而且还提供更好的教材和教学方式，让孩子快乐地学习、成长。如果他们的能力可以变得更强，将来就能为社会贡献一份力量了。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng de lìzi yì nián bǐ yì nián duō. Yìzhí dào zuìjìn jǐ nián, jiāzhǎng hé lǎoshī zhōngyú míngbái měi ge háizi dōu shì dútè de, búshì měi gè rén dōu fēi niàn dàxué bùkě. Zàishuō, kǎoshì chéngjī hǎo de rén, bù yídìng jiù néng xìngfú guòrìzi. Yīncǐ, yǒuyìyì de xuéxí shì ràng háizi yǐ sīkǎo dàitì jì dá'àn, bù jǐn gěi háizi zìyóu de kōngjiān, fāhuī chū zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, érqiě hái tígōng gèng hǎo de jiàocái hé jiàoxué fāngshì, ràng háizi kuàilè de xuéxí, chéngzhǎng. Rúguǒ tāmen de nénglì kěyǐ biàn de gèng qiáng, jiānglái jiù néng wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng le.
text.english: Such examples multiply year after year. Only in recent years have parents and educators finally realized that each child is unique and not everyone must attend university. Furthermore, individuals with high test scores do not necessarily lead happier lives. Therefore, meaningful learning lets children think instead of memorizing answers. It not only gives children the freedom to bring out their own strengths, but also provides better teaching materials and teaching methods so that children can learn and grow happily. If their capabilities grow stronger, they will be able to do their part for society in the future.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight the most prominent or noteworthy item within a broader category using 尤其是.
grammarPages.explanation: 「尤其」是副詞，有「特別」的意思，表示和其他事物比起來更特別。一般放在後面的句子。「尤其」＋「是」有強調的意思。

text.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。
text.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。
text.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì yìzhí dōu hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de xuéxí biǎoxiàn, yóuqíshì kǎoshì de chéngjī.
text.english: Taiwanese society has always placed great importance on students' academic performance, especially their exam scores.

text.traditional: 這個學期我選了五門課，每門課都很有意思，尤其是英文會話課，不僅教授的教法活潑，說話也很幽默。
text.simplified: 这个学期我选了五门课，每门课都很有意思，尤其是英文会话课，不仅教授的教法活泼，说话也很幽默。
text.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí wǒ xuǎn le wǔ mén kè, měi mén kè dōu hěn yǒuyìsi, yóuqíshì Yīngwén huìhuà kè, bù jǐn jiàoshòu de jiàofǎ huópō, shuōhuà yě hěn yōumò.
text.english: I'm taking five courses this semester, and they're all interesting, especially English conversation. Not only is the professor's teaching lively, but the professor is also very funny.

text.traditional: 每種工作都有它的困難或問題，尤其是當警察的，經常會碰到麻煩或危險的事情。
text.simplified: 每种工作都有它的困难或问题，尤其是当警察的，经常会碰到麻烦或危险的事情。
text.pinyin: Měi zhǒng gōngzuò dōu yǒu tā de kùnnán huò wèntí, yóuqíshì dāng jǐngchá de, jīngcháng huì pèngdào máfán huò wéixiǎn de shìqíng.
text.english: Every job has its difficulties or problems, especially police work: police officers often run into trouble or danger.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 尤其 is an adverb similar to 特別, which means that something is more special compared to something else. Usually placed in the following sentence. 尤其+是 has the meaning of emphasis.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Reaching an Aim or Not with V得著 / V不著 / V著了 / 沒V著
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether an action reaches its aim, like finding something (找著了) or guessing right (猜得著), with verbs such as 拿, 看, 打, 猜, 用 and 找.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示做某個動作，但達不到某種目的或結果。「著(zháo)」前面的動詞具有一定的目標性，動作有「接觸或達到」的意思，常用的有「拿、看、打、猜、用、找」等。「著」在此語法作為結構補語，說明前面動詞的結果。例如：鑰匙找著了/沒找著。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得/不 + 著 (+ Object)

text.traditional: ……把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。
text.simplified: ……把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。
text.pinyin: …Bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài biàntiáo shàng, yǐwéi háizi fùxí shí yòngdezháo, zhèyàng kǎoshì de chéngjī jiù huì gèng hǎo.
text.english: …write the key points on notes, thinking their kids could use them when reviewing, so that their exam scores would be even better.

text.traditional: 那個專櫃裡放著好多漂亮的名牌皮包，可惜我沒錢買，看得著、摸不著。
text.simplified: 那个专柜里放着好多漂亮的名牌皮包，可惜我没钱买，看得着、摸不着。
text.pinyin: Nàge zhuānguì lǐ fàng zhe hǎoduō piàoliàng de míngpái píbāo, kěxí wǒ méi qián mǎi, kàndezháo, mōbùzháo.
text.english: That display counter holds lots of beautiful designer handbags; unfortunately I can't afford to buy one. I can see them but can't touch them.

text.traditional:
A：游小姐的男朋友看起來很年輕，你猜他幾歲？
B：我跟他不熟，哪裡猜得著。
text.simplified:
A：游小姐的男朋友看起来很年轻，你猜他几岁？
B：我跟他不熟，哪里猜得着。
text.pinyin:
A: Yóu xiǎojiě de nánpéngyǒu kànqǐlái hěn niánqīng, nǐ cāi tā jǐ suì?
B: Wǒ gēn tā bù shóu, nǎlǐ cāidezháo.
text.english:
A: Miss You's boyfriend looks very young; how old do you guess he is?
B: I don't know him well; how could I possibly guess?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: It expresses a certain action, but one which can not achieve a certain purpose or result. The verb in front of 著(zháo) has a certain purpose, and the action it expresses has to do with “contact or reach”. Commonly used verbs are 拿, 看, 打, 猜, 用, 找, etc. 著 here is to work as a structural complement, indicating the result of the preceding verb. For example, 鑰匙找著了/沒找著.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one thing or action is used in place of another with 以……代替…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「以」有「用」的意思，「以……代替……」意思是用某樣東西或某個行動來替換原本的東西或行動。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以 + Substitute + 代替 + Original

text.traditional: 因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案……
text.simplified: 因此，有意义的学习是让孩子以思考代替记答案……
text.pinyin: Yīncǐ, yǒu yìyì de xuéxí shì ràng háizi yǐ sīkǎo dàitì jì dá'àn…
text.english: Therefore, meaningful learning means letting children think instead of memorizing answers…

text.traditional: 媽媽很重視家人的健康，常以蔬菜水果做成的點心代替一般的甜點。
text.simplified: 妈妈很重视家人的健康，常以蔬菜水果做成的点心代替一般的甜点。
text.pinyin: Māma hěn zhòngshì jiārén de jiànkāng, cháng yǐ shūcài shuǐguǒ zuò chéng de diǎnxīn dàitì yìbān de tiándiǎn.
text.english: Mom values the family's health, so she often uses snacks made from vegetables and fruit in place of ordinary desserts.

text.traditional: 如果大家都能以搭公車、騎自行車代替開車，這樣空氣就不會那麼髒了。
text.simplified: 如果大家都能以搭公车、骑自行车代替开车，这样空气就不会那么脏了。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ dàjiā dōu néng yǐ dā gōngchē, qí zìxíngchē dàitì kāichē, zhèyàng kōngqì jiù bú huì nàme zāng le.
text.english: If everyone could take the bus or ride bicycles instead of driving, the air would not be so dirty.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以 is similar to 用. 以……代替 means replacing some thing or action.
